verdict.rationale: Postmark's pricing documents fully managed dedicated IPs as an add-on for customers sending 300,000+ emails per month, which covers the 'outgrow shared pools' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes IP warmup: no automated ramp-up and no published warmup schedule. 'Fully managed' only implies warmup may be handled. Missing for 10: documented automated warmup/ramp-up, a published warmup schedule, details on how a customer migrates from shared pools to a dedicated IP, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools

citations.quote: Dedicated IPs: Fully managed dedicated IPs, available to customers sending 300,000 emails per month or more.
